playbook-uplift/models/verus/update_steps.rs::step_walk walks the input sequence steps in order; wf is a premise on that sequence
entries.gap: The walk order (classes ascending, all-member list before primary-only, author order) is the premise wf on the input step sequence; inst_ok_update_runs_in_walk_order only shows the log follows the given sequence, and class_list (class-number map) is not connected to the walk. Weakening wf to distinct keys (G2-m59) fails only the helper inst_lemma_flag_step, which needs class contiguity for the newStepToApply flag: the order is assumed there, not derived.
